notes.title: Patch Release & Sale
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Dog Fight will has received its first patch!

The ultimate couch party game. Battle head to head with up to 8 players (cooperatively or versus). Or test your skill against waves of ever amassing enemies.

To celebrate the release, we are having a sale of 25% off! Starting from the 25th April 2016

Patch Notes:
v1
- Updated unreal engine 4.11 release
- Escape & Gamepad Back buttons return to main menu
- Better menu navigation using gamepads (still some issues, remaining engine issue)
- Performance/stuttering improvments
- Fix for more than 4 xinput game controllers on windows
- Gamepads now display their name in the menu
- Added gamepad deadzone
- Fixed cross platform multiplayer issues

notes.title: Release And Pre-Orders Available
notes.notes:
Dog Fight is now available for pre-order via the steam page.
It will be available to play from Friday 29th January.

We are keen to get feedback from the community, so do hit up the forums when you get a chance.

notes.title: New Release Trailer & Screens!
notes.notes: We have been working hard over the last month to get ready for release. Currently we are in the final testing stage, and have had an opportunity to release a new trailer and fresh screen grabs of the game!
